title: Active Inference
subtitle: A twelve-week course that does the algebra the textbooks leave out, and lets you turn every knob.
eyebrow: Open course · University of Cape Town

parts.I. Inference: From Bayes’ theorem to the variational bound
parts.III. Discrete time: POMDPs, expected free energy, policy selection

weeks.title: The hypothesis-testing agent
weeks.summary: Why anything that persists must carry a model of what it persists in, and why running that model backwards is the hard direction.

weeks.title: Hidden state estimation
weeks.summary: Two rules a physical nervous system has to obey, and a nonlinear inference problem that breaks exact methods. Maximum a posteriori by gradient ascent on the log joint, whose gradient turns out to be two precision-weighted prediction errors: predictive coding, derived rather than assumed. Then what the mode costs you.

weeks.title: Learning the model
weeks.summary: Parameters as another kind of hidden state. Bayesian linear regression, linear Gaussian systems, and expectation maximisation as the bridge to what comes next.

weeks.title: Variational free energy
weeks.summary: The heart of the course. Jensen’s inequality, the bound on surprise, and the three decompositions of free energy written out line by line.

weeks.title: Predictive coding
weeks.summary: Free energy under a Laplace approximation becomes precision-weighted prediction error. A single unit, then many, then a hierarchy.

weeks.title: Generalised coordinates of motion
weeks.summary: Why a state is not enough and you need its velocity, acceleration and beyond. Smooth noise, generalised measurements, and the shift operator.

weeks.title: Generalised filtering
weeks.summary: Assembling the generalised state-space model and the recognition dynamics that track a trajectory rather than a point.

weeks.title: Action, learning and attention
weeks.summary: Autonomous states close the loop: the agent changes its sensations instead of its beliefs. Then learning the parameters and tuning the precisions.

weeks.title: Discrete generative models
weeks.summary: Partially observable Markov decision processes, and the matrices A, B, C, D and E that specify one. State inference by variational message passing.

weeks.title: Expected free energy
weeks.summary: Risk and ambiguity, information gain and pragmatic value, proved equal rather than asserted equal. Then the vectorised form, with every index accounted for.

weeks.title: Policy selection and learning
weeks.summary: Choosing what to do by softmax over expected free energy. Precision, habits, Dirichlet learning of the model itself, and adding factorial and hierarchical depth.

weeks.title: Extensions, connections and objections
weeks.summary: Sophisticated inference and structure learning; how active inference relates to reinforcement learning and control as inference; and the criticisms that deserve a serious answer.
